description: Make a new layernote project in the workspace this token is for: FIGMA for a Figma design (then bring its screens in with import_figma_frames), STATIC_FILES for pictures, PDFs and videos (then upload_file), or WEBSITE for a live site (give websiteUrl). It counts against the workspace’s plan like a project made in the app, and is the user’s, made in their name. Only create one when the user asks.

figmaFileUrl.description: For FIGMA: the Figma file to link, as Figma copies it

type.description: FIGMA: a Figma design. STATIC_FILES: uploaded files. WEBSITE: a live site

websiteUrl.description: For WEBSITE: the site’s address, e.g. https://example.com

name: create_project
title: Create a project
